```{r}

first_stage_test_bis_nuclear <- first_stage_data %>%
  mutate(Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity + Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
    nuclear_unavailability_creneau = (Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity >0)) %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(creneau_unavailability = sum(nuclear_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE))%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date) %>%
  mutate(day_unavailability = sum(nuclear_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE))%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(datetime)

my_test_nuclear <- first_stage_test_bis_nuclear %>% 
  filter(day_unavailability > 0) %>% 
  arrange(datetime)



#il faut regarder si l'on est un seuil
# à savoir si le même creneau  de l'auction suivante 
# a une indisponibilité différente

my_test_nuclear <- my_test_nuclear %>% 
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(unavailability_trigger =  ifelse(auction_before ==0, nuclear_unavailability_creneau, nuclear_unavailability_creneau -  lag(nuclear_unavailability_creneau)),
 unavailability_trigger = ifelse(unavailability_trigger==-1, 0, unavailability_trigger)) %>%
  ungroup()



log_price_data_nuclear <- my_test_nuclear  %>% 
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  
  # Définir l'enchère de référence
  mutate(
      auction_before = as.numeric(auction_before), 
    reference_auction = ifelse(creneau_unavailability== 0, 
     sample(0:6, 1), min(auction_before[unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),
     unavail_pub_level = ifelse(creneau_unavailability== 0, 
       0, min(Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity[unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),
     unavail_unpub_level = ifelse(creneau_unavailability== 0, 
       0, min(Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity[unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),
    distance_auction = as.numeric(auction_before) - as.numeric(reference_auction),
    unavail_level = ifelse(creneau_unavailability== 0, 
      0, min(Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity[unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),
   unavail_pub = unavail_pub_level* unavailability_trigger,
   unavail_unpub = unavail_unpub_level* unavailability_trigger,
   unavail = unavail_level* unavailability_trigger
   ) %>%
  
  # Agréger les valeurs si plusieurs existent par (date, creneau, distance)
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, distance_auction, unavail_pub, unavail_unpub, unavail) %>%
  summarise(price_diff = mean(price_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 
            reference_auction = first(reference_auction),
            Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity = mean(Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity, na.rm = TRUE),
            Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity = mean(Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity, na.rm = TRUE),
            
            Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity = mean(Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  
  # Transformer en format large par distance_auction
  pivot_wider(names_from = distance_auction, 
              names_prefix = "price_", 
              values_from = price_diff)
```

```{r}
#il y a souvent annonce, puis désannonce (à savoir fin de l'indisponibilité à un créneau suivant)
#attention je perds de la variation

library(lmtest)
library(data.table)
library(sandwich)

log_price_data_nuclear_grouped <- log_price_data_nuclear %>%  
  arrange(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, unavail_pub, unavail_unpub) %>% 
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  summarize(across(starts_with("price"), ~ ifelse(all(is.na(.)), NA, sum(., na.rm = TRUE))),
            creneau = first(creneau),
            reference_auction = first(reference_auction),
            unavail_pub = last(unavail_pub),
            unavail_unpub = last(unavail_unpub),
            unavail = last(unavail),
            electricity_delivery_date = first(electricity_delivery_date),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(unavail_pub) & !is.na(unavail_pub))

log_price_data_nuclear_grouped <- left_join(log_price_data_nuclear_grouped,
                                              first_stage_data %>% 
                                                select(electricity_delivery_date,creneau, gen_tot,
                                                       unpredicted_renewables, intraday_update_renewables, day_ahead_forecast, month, year, weekday) %>%  distinct(),
                                                by = c("electricity_delivery_date", "creneau"))

```


```{r}


table_coefficients_nuclear  <- data.frame()

for (col in colnames(log_price_data_nuclear_grouped)[3:10]){
  # Créer la formule pour la régression
  formula <- as.formula(paste("`" , col, "`" , " ~ unavail_pub + unavail_unpub + 
                              intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables + as.factor(reference_auction) + gen_tot
                              " , sep = ""))
  # Ajuster le modèle
  model <- lm(formula, data = log_price_data_nuclear_grouped)
  
  vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(model, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ electricity_delivery_date)
  # Erreurs standard clusterisées
  cl_se<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
  
  
  coefficients <- summary(model)$coefficients
  n_ddl <- summary(model)$df[2]
  # Créer un dataframe temporaire avec les variables et les coefficients
  temp_pub <- data.frame(status = "Published",
                         variable = col,
                        estimate = coefficients[2, 1],  # Estimation du coefficient
                        std_error = cl_se[2],  # Erreur standard modifiée
                        t_value = coefficients[2, 1] / cl_se[2],  # Recalcul de la valeur t
                        p_value = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(coefficients[2, 1] / cl_se[2]), df = n_ddl)))  # Recalcul de
  
  temp_unpub <- data.frame(status = "Unpublished",
                           variable = col,
                        estimate = coefficients[2, 2],  # Estimation du coefficient
                        std_error = cl_se[3],  # Erreur standard modifiée
                        t_value = coefficients[2, 2] / cl_se[3],  # Recalcul de la valeur t
                        p_value = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(coefficients[2, 2] / cl_se[3]), df = n_ddl)))  # Recalcul de
  
  
  
  # Ajouter les résultats à table_coefficients
  table_coefficients_nuclear  <- rbind(table_coefficients_nuclear , temp_pub)
  table_coefficients_nuclear  <- rbind(table_coefficients_nuclear ,  temp_unpub)
}

```




```{r}

table_coefficients_nuclear_bis  <- data.frame()

for (col in colnames(log_price_data_nuclear_grouped)[3:10]){
  # Créer la formule pour la régression
  formula <- as.formula(paste("`" , col, "`" , " ~ unavail + 
                              intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables + as.factor(reference_auction) + gen_tot + as.factor(creneau)
                              " , sep = ""))
  # Ajuster le modèle
  model <- lm(formula, data = log_price_data_nuclear_grouped)
  
  vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(model, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ electricity_delivery_date)
  # Erreurs standard clusterisées
  cl_se<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
  
  
  coefficients <- summary(model)$coefficients
  n_ddl <- summary(model)$df[2]
  # Créer un dataframe temporaire avec les variables et les coefficients
  temp_df <- data.frame(variable = col,
                        estimate = coefficients[2, 1],  # Estimation du coefficient
                        std_error = cl_se[2],  # Erreur standard modifiée
                        t_value = coefficients[2, 1] / cl_se[2],  # Recalcul de la valeur t
                        p_value = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(coefficients[2, 1] / cl_se[2]), df = n_ddl)))  # Recalcul de
  
  
  # Ajouter les résultats à table_coefficients
  table_coefficients_nuclear_bis   <- rbind(table_coefficients_nuclear_bis ,  temp_df)
}

```

```{r}
table_coefficients_nuclear_bis <- table_coefficients_nuclear_bis %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)))



ggplot(data = table_coefficients_nuclear_bis) +
  geom_point(aes(x = as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)), 
                 y = estimate)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)), 
                    ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std_error,
                    ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std_error), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Dynamic response to nuclear plan availability shock",
       x = "Auction",
       y = "EUR/MWh") +
  theme_minimal()
```
